title: Check Active Robot Count and Charging Robots Count on Map Monitor Summary
summary: Use the Map Monitor summary metrics to quickly verify how many robots are actively running and how many are actively charging at the moment.
when_to_use: When you need a fast snapshot of system activity by reading the Map Monitor summary counts for robots actively running and robots actively charging.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Read the Map Monitor summary metrics and report the active robot count and robots charging count.
access_or_tools_needed: Visibility into the “active robot count” and “robots charging” metrics

visual_references.description: Map Monitor Message Panel showing the summary metrics including “active robot count” and the “robots charging” count example (e.g., 10).
Map Monitor Message Panel label area showing “Count of active Robots” and “Count of Robots charging”.

steps.title: Locate the “active robot count” metric on the Map Monitor summary area
steps.purpose: Find the metric that indicates how many robots are actively running in the system.
steps.instruction: On the Map Monitor summary area, locate the metric labeled “active robot count”.
steps.expected_result: You can see the “active robot count” value displayed in the Map Monitor summary.
steps.healthy_condition: The “active robot count” metric is visible and has a numeric value.
steps.failure_condition: The “active robot count” metric is not visible or does not show a numeric value.

actions.label: Find active robot count metric
actions.exact_action: Locate the “active robot count” metric on the Map Monitor summary area.

steps.title: Read the “active robot count” value
steps.purpose: Capture the current number of robots actively running.
steps.instruction: Read the “active robot count” value shown on the Map Monitor summary.
steps.expected_result: You record the numeric “active robot count” value currently displayed.
steps.healthy_condition: The recorded value is a clear integer shown next to “active robot count”.
steps.failure_condition: The value is unclear, missing, or appears inconsistent with the displayed metric label.

actions.label: Record active robot count
actions.exact_action: Read the “active robot count” value to determine how many robots are actively running in the system.

steps.title: Locate the “robots charging” metric
steps.purpose: Find the metric that indicates how many robots are actively charging.
steps.instruction: On the Map Monitor summary area, locate the metric labeled “robots charging” (described as the next point showing robots actively charging).
steps.expected_result: You can see the “robots charging” metric and its numeric value.
steps.healthy_condition: The “robots charging” metric is visible and shows a numeric count.
steps.failure_condition: The “robots charging” metric is not visible or does not show a numeric value.

actions.label: Find robots charging metric
actions.exact_action: Locate the “robots charging” metric (described as the next point showing robots actively charging).

steps.title: Read the “robots charging” count value
steps.purpose: Capture the current number of robots actively charging.
steps.instruction: Read the “robots charging” count value shown on the Map Monitor summary.
steps.expected_result: You record the numeric “robots charging” count currently displayed (example described: “10” means 10 robots actively charging at the moment).
steps.healthy_condition: The recorded value is a clear integer shown next to “robots charging”.
steps.failure_condition: The value is unclear, missing, or does not match the displayed metric label.

actions.label: Record robots charging count
actions.exact_action: Read the charging count value (example given: “10” means 10 robots actively charging at the moment).

steps.title: Check for inconsistency with observed operations and escalate if needed
steps.purpose: Determine whether the summary counts align with what you observe and trigger deeper investigation when they do not.
steps.instruction: If the charging count (and/or active robot count) appears inconsistent with observed physical activity, note the values and escalate for deeper investigation beyond the summary metrics.
steps.expected_result: Either (a) counts align with observed activity, or (b) you have documented the active robot count and robots charging count and escalated for deeper investigation.
steps.healthy_condition: The summary counts match the expected level of activity you observe on the floor.
steps.failure_condition: The summary counts do not align with observed physical activity.

actions.label: Compare counts to observed activity
actions.exact_action: If the charging count appears inconsistent with expected operations, note the values for escalation or further checks.

stop_or_escalate_if: Counts do not align with observed physical activity

success_criteria: You successfully read and record the Map Monitor summary “active robot count” value.
You successfully read and record the Map Monitor summary “robots charging” count value.
healthy_conditions: Map Monitor summary shows both “active robot count” and “robots charging” with numeric values.
The values reflect the number of robots actively running and actively charging at the moment.
failure_conditions: “active robot count” or “robots charging” metrics are not visible or do not show numeric values.
Counts do not align with observed physical activity.
escalation_guidance: If counts do not align with observed physical activity, escalate for deeper investigation beyond the summary metrics.
